claim: As a general feature of CloudWatch alarms, there is no limit to the number of alarms you can create in your account; some alarm types still have their own per-account limits, for example the maximum number of Log Alarms per account.

qualifiers.scope: per account, all alarms in general
qualifiers.condition: Log Alarms have their own per-account maximum.

evidence.quote: You can create as many alarms as you want in your AWS account.
There is no limit to the number of alarms that you can create.
| Maximum Log Alarms per account | \~1000 (limited by CloudWatch Logs AWS managed Scheduled Query quota) | No |
